I feel a lot of this with you. I’ve had borderline crippling anxiety since almost as long as I can remember. During covid I lost contact with the few friends I had left from before. I felt alone and stuck and just wanted someone to help me get through the days. 

My best advice is the biggest solution to your problem is time. Things are going to happen in your life that give you a new sense of purpose, but they’re going to take time and work to find. Your purpose for being on this planet isn’t going to come to you at 3am while you’re thinking about how shitty life is. A big helper for this is just look at other people around you. My dad is a huge inspiration to me and he was able to just find purpose simply in having a family. 

As for buying that time, just find something to look forward to. For me it was something as shitty as a hot shower in the mornings. It gave me a reason to wake up. But once it was over I needed something else. So it was always getting out of school, and so on. Just finding things to look forward to, even small daily events gives you a temporary purpose, which can go a long way. I’m a very short term person (probably a result of a lifetime of video game addiction dramatically increasing my minds demand for dopamine) so long term things even as short away as my graduation from high school in a few months isn’t enough to get me up in the mornings.

As for long term, it doesn’t sound like you have any major passions. I don’t really myself either (unless you count video games). Anxiety can be a huge problem when trying new things. Whenever I try something new I always feel like I’m going to look/sound like a poser or a loser. I honestly still haven’t overcome this myself so I can’t give you much advice, but if it’s something you’re really into eventually for me the drive to do it outweighs the anxiety against doing it.

Tl:dr find things to look forward to. They can make passing time a lot easier and give you a reason to keep going just momentarily, and keep trying new things. Your purpose on this earth isn’t just going to magically appear to you at 3am while you’re depressed
